title: Chat/typing server behavior: per-recipient check ambiguous for group chats
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, the Chat/typing Server Behavior section says 'Before delivering a typing push event to the owner of a Chat, the server MUST check the Chat`s receiveTypingIndicators field'. In a group or channel chat, every participant has their own Chat record with their own receiveTypingIndicators preference. The phrase 'the owner of a Chat' does not make clear that this check must be applied individually for each potential recipient against that recipient's own Chat record. An implementor could incorrectly read this as a single check against the chat creator's record, or against the sender's record, rather than a per-recipient check. The text should say something like 'for each participant to whom the event would be delivered, the server MUST check that participant's Chat record'.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
